visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a black sweatshirt is leaning over the trunk of a dark grey car, pointing enthusiastically at the inner panels. The scene is set in a bright, modern indoor car showroom with other luxury vehicles parked in the background. (2) The camera moves to a macro view of the car's interior metal components as the man uses a smartphone flashlight to highlight missing weld points. He gestures with precision, showing signs of technical inspection. The lighting is focused and artificial. (3) The man moves to the side of the car to inspect the door frames, running his fingers along the seams to point out further anomalies in the chassis. He looks serious and engaged in the task. (4) The scene shifts to the front of the vehicle with the hood open, revealing the engine. The man points at specific mechanical parts, such as the timing chain, while speaking directly to the camera with high energy. (5) The man stands next to the car for a final summary, gesturing toward the entire vehicle as text overlays indicating price and model year appear on the screen. The background features branding signs for the dealership.
